mode.description: material/status without plan_id reads existing current work. begin registers optional calibration, not core work, and requires family, falsifier_class, expected_evidence_class, consequence_class, declared_steps, budget_calls; plan_id is optional only with a host call reference. apply requires plan_id, apply_id, step_id, kind_class, from_class, to_class, count. grade requires plan_id, result_class. advise requires plan_id, control_class; history_cursor is optional. abandon requires plan_id. To read a registered plan, supply plan_id with material/status. Supply only fields for the selected mode.

plan_id.description: Existing registration ID. Omit for a read of current work; begin may generate an ID from the host call reference.

family.description: Short ASCII token label using letters, digits, or ._:-; no spaces or prose.

session_id.description: Optional begin assertion only: must equal the host-supplied acting work session. Cannot create or select a session.

description: Current-work reads and begin require an existing acting core work session; use core work action=start description=... for new work. An existing session may be read with review work_session_id. Modes have distinct required inputs described on mode.
